name: Approximate a ratio inside a divisor-sum fiber
description: construct() -> [a,b], positive Python integers <=10000000. Require sigma(a)=sigma(b), where sigma includes ALL positive divisors. Minimize |a/b-3/2|. Factorization and rational error are exact; the score is the binary64 serialization of that rational, with its exact numerator/denominator reported. Only the target 3/2 and inputs bounded by ten million are evaluated. A smaller exact rational error is a finite approximation, not a density proof for all positive real targets. Tiny error differences can round to the same floating score.
